services.name: Lunch Cruise
services.desc: Enjoy a relaxing evening on the water aboard the River Queen’s Sunset Dinner Cruise, a classic Mississippi-style riverboat sailing from Brielle, New Jersey. Savor a buffet-style dinner featuring favorites such as sliced top round of beef, rosemary chicken and penne alla vodka while taking in the beautiful sunset views along the Manasquan River and Jersey Shore waterways. As the River Queen cruises through the calm inland waters near Point Pleasant, guests can enjoy the warm evening breeze, glowing sky, and waterfront scenery that make this one of the most memorable summer cruises on the Jersey Shore.
